parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Industry Report Aggregator
Runs every Monday at 7 AM.
3 parallel Perplexity searches:
- Market reports and statistics
- VC funding and M&A activity
- Regulatory changes
GPT-4o compiles into structured weekly brief.
Includes FLOOWBOX-specific opportunities.
Saves to Notion + Slack digest.

Change industry in Set Industry Config node.
